subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace manifests larger than 16 MiB and symlink/non-regular manifest paths fail closed by default?
rationale: The implementation correctly removes an unbounded allocation path, but it intentionally changes accepted inputs for existing local and cloned marketplaces.

options.title: Accept bounded regular-file manifests
options.body: Adopt the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only behavior as intentional marketplace hardening.

options.title: Tune the compatibility boundary
options.body: Choose a different cap or permitted file-kind policy before merge while retaining a bounded read.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Keep the PR open if marketplace manifest compatibility expectations are not ready to be set.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded regular-file manifests
recommendation.body: Adopt the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only behavior as intentional marketplace hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the affected marketplace loader and its input behavior.
